data.title: Documents are linked, not stored
data.why: Git already versions a markdown file and git log already shows its history, so an event model adds nothing to the document itself. What git cannot express is that this file explains this task. Probe D measured the gap: grep finds the answering document every time and buries it among 10-35 candidates, 1.3 MB of candidates against 39 KB of linked documents.
data.rejected: A kadence doc command that creates and stores documents — a wrapper around touch, and the same second-way-to-say-the-same-thing we rejected for MCP.
